verdict.rationale: The platform's core interaction model is delegating scientific tasks (literature review, data analysis, hypothesis generation) to built-in autonomous agents like Kosmos, Precedent, and Molecules, with a documented client (`run_tasks_until_done`) showing explicit task delegation and autonomous execution with cited, auditable outputs. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs, and confirmation the in-app UI (not just the API client) supports the same delegation flow.
